title: The Leo look: dusk, daylight and neon, on and off live

steps.title: Make a private folder for the profiles
Copy dusk.json to the capture Mac
cmux: clear; echo  | base64 -d > "$LEO_DIR/dusk.json" && echo saved dusk

steps.title: Copy daylight.json to the capture Mac
cmux: clear; echo  | base64 -d > "$LEO_DIR/daylight.json" && echo saved daylight

steps.title: Copy neon.json to the capture Mac
cmux: clear; echo  | base64 -d > "$LEO_DIR/neon.json" && echo saved neon

steps.title: Before: cmux as it ships
cmux:
clear; for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do printf '\033[4%sm      ' $i; done; printf '\033[0m
'; for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do printf '\033[10%sm      ' $i; done; printf '\033[0m

'; printf '\033[32msuccess\033[0m  \033[33mwarning\033[0m  \033[31mdanger\033[0m  \033[34mhighlight\033[0m  \033[35mmagenta\033[0m  \033[36mcyan\033[0m

'

steps.title: dusk: cmux customize use dusk.json
cmux:
clear; for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do printf '\033[4%sm      ' $i; done; printf '\033[0m
'; for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do printf '\033[10%sm      ' $i; done; printf '\033[0m

'; printf '\033[32msuccess\033[0m  \033[33mwarning\033[0m  \033[31mdanger\033[0m  \033[34mhighlight\033[0m  \033[35mmagenta\033[0m  \033[36mcyan\033[0m

'; cmux customize use "$LEO_DIR/dusk.json" | head -n 1

steps.title: daylight: cmux customize discard, then use daylight.json
cmux:
clear; for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do printf '\033[4%sm      ' $i; done; printf '\033[0m
'; for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do printf '\033[10%sm      ' $i; done; printf '\033[0m

'; printf '\033[32msuccess\033[0m  \033[33mwarning\033[0m  \033[31mdanger\033[0m  \033[34mhighlight\033[0m  \033[35mmagenta\033[0m  \033[36mcyan\033[0m

'; cmux customize discard >/dev/null; cmux customize use "$LEO_DIR/daylight.json" | head -n 1
